design_philosophy: High-Performance Minimalism. Clean, scientific, energetic, and data-driven visual hierarchy.

primary_background.name: Chalkboard Black / Pitch Black
primary_background.use_case: Main background across the website to create an elite, dark, and high-contrast premium feel.

secondary_background.name: Asphalt Gray
secondary_background.use_case: Card backgrounds, section dividers, and subtle containers to separate content.

primary_text.name: Pure White
primary_text.use_case: Main headlines, primary body text, and absolute readability against the dark theme.

accent_color_1.name: Neon Electric Green / Volt
accent_color_1.use_case: The ultimate high-visibility color representing power, speed, Output Sports sensors, and energy. Used strictly for Call-to-Actions (CTAs), highlights, data points, and active states.

accent_color_2.name: Data Gray / Silver
accent_color_2.use_case: Secondary text, labels, units of measurement (e.g., m/s, GCT, SSC), and non-active border lines.

ux_ui_guidelines.layout_style: Clean & Minimalist. The user's focus must always sit entirely on the performance metrics, the elite athlete footage, and precise value propositions. Avoid unnecessary decorations, complex vectors, or messy patterns.
ux_ui_guidelines.white_space_strategy: Generous use of padding and empty space (macro whitespace) between sections. This gives the premium content room to 'breathe' and heightens the elite, high-end feel of the GUG digital ecosystem.

background_video_spec.execution: Short, 3-5 second high-definition, high-contrast video clips running silently on a continuous loop in the background of the hero section. Footage must showcase real action: slow-motion acceleration, violent deceleration cuts, ankle stiffness loading, or VBT tracking.
background_video_spec.overlay: Must feature a dark semi-transparent overlay (Linear Gradient or 40-60% black opacity) to guarantee absolute contrast and crisp readability for text placed on top.

animations_and_transitions.scroll_reveals: Subtle, smooth fade-in and slide-up animations (e.g., Duration: 0.6s, Easing: ease-out) as the user scrolls down to discover performance tiers or data breakdowns.
animations_and_transitions.hover_states: Interactive elements (Buttons, Program Cards) must instantly respond with a crisp transition. CTAs expand slightly or glow into the Neon Volt Green (#39FF14).

buttons_and_ctas.shape: Sharp rectangular borders or micro-rounded corners (max 4px radius) to maintain a rigid, aggressive, and athletic architectural vibe.
